title: Retrieval eval harness and a tenant-filtered Retrieve call
area: RAG and vector stores on AWS
scenario: The platform team wants to move Tidewater Ask's Knowledge Base from fixed-size to hierarchical chunking. Build the one Retrieve request builder every caller must use, so the tenant metadata filter cannot be forgotten or widened, and an eval harness that turns a 20-question golden set into recall@5, MRR, per-tenant numbers, a leak check and a go/no-go gate.
task: Build Retrieve requests with a mandatory tenant_id filter ANDed with user filters
Compute recall@k and MRR over unique documents, per tenant
Flag any result from another tenant (or untagged) as a hard failure
Compare two KB configurations and gate the change; recommend in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Requests validate against the real Retrieve model; no path drops or widens the tenant filter
Fixture run reproduces both configs' recall and finds the leaking question
Gate blocks on any leak and on a per-tenant floor

practices.label: Week 3 Wed - metadata filters and multi-tenancy
